answer.reason: GLOSSARY.md names all five phases (reserved, guaranteed, in-house, departed, cancelled) and ties house rules to each one: the 48-hour release, the no-show charge, folio posting and the cancellation fee. The core branches on those rules (release-unpaid-rooms, the in-house check), so the domain owns these distinctions even though they line up one for one with RoomsHub's codes.
